title: Lightly Smoked Russian Corned Beef Pirozhki
description: A twist on traditional Russian pirozhki, featuring corned beef and a hint of herbal flavors. These savory pastries are perfect for a quick lunch or snack.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and 1/4 cup of warm water. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups of flour, salt, and yeast mixture.
Add egg, infuse-oil, and chopped onion to the dry ingredients. Mix until a dough forms.
Gradually add the remaining 1/2 cup of flour, kneading the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle and place a tablespoon of corned beef in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling, forming a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges to seal.
Bake the pirozhki for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
